Hi Clara / Ethan —

Thanks again for the time today — really appreciated the candid run-through of how Medix ingests clinical notes and the latency constraints for your patient-facing workflows. Quick recap and a proposed path forward so we can get an evaluation moving: 

1) Goal for the next call: technical deep dive + align evaluation plan (success criteria, prompt set, sample dataset, and integration constraints).
2) Duration: 60 minutes (we'll split 30m tech deep-dive / 30m evaluation plan & success criteria).
3) Proposed success criteria (draft): average 95th percentile latency < 300ms for 512 tokens; generation accuracy on labeled set >= 88% by our eval harness; end-to-end integration proof-of-concept for one workflow within 2 weeks of kickoff.

Attached is a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP_proposal_v1.pdf) and a prompt set template (prompt_set_template.csv) to make the evaluation concrete. Can you confirm who from your side should join (ML/infra/stakeholders)?

For calendar slots, we have these open next week (PST):
- Tue 1/26 10:00–11:00
- Wed 1/27 14:00–15:00
- Thu 1/28 09:00–10:00

If none of these work, propose two windows that do and we'll prioritize. Also let us know if you need a security/compliance pre-read — we can surface SOC 2 docs and data handling notes ahead of the call.

Next steps: if you confirm a slot and attendees, I'll send a calendar invite with an agenda and prep items.

Best,
